text: 我还真曾在贴吧里和别人就这个问题辩论过。
en: I have actually once debated this very issue with others on Tieba.

text: 还是经典的“如果卖淫合法了，你会接受你的家人从事性工作吗？
en: It was the classic "If prostitution were legalised, would you accept your family members engaging in sex work?

text: ”提问。
en: " question.

text: 他说“性工作也是一种工作，工作就分三六九等，比如扫大街掏大粪也是一种合法的工作，你愿意让家里人去吗？
en: He said, "Sex work is also a kind of work; work is stratified into different grades. For example, street sweeping and latrine cleaning are also legitimate work — would you want your family to do that?

text: 我的回答是“如果真的没别的工作了，扫大街掏大粪也没什么丢人的，我的态度是：虽然不愿意但也能接受家人去扫大街掏大粪。
en: My answer was, "If there really were no other work, street sweeping and latrine cleaning would be nothing to be ashamed of. My attitude is: although I would not wish it, I could still accept my family doing street sweeping and latrine cleaning.

text: 现在该你表态了：你能接受让家人从事性工作吗？
en: Now it is your turn to state your position: can you accept your family engaging in sex work?"

text: 然后他不理我了。
en: Then he ignored me.

text: 看到题目还以为在反讽玩梗，点进来居然这么这么这么多的人真心可惜嫖娼不合法，给我看愣了，没记错的话咱们是社会主义国家吧
en: Seeing the title, I thought it was sarcasm or a meme; clicking in, I was stunned to find so, so, so many people genuinely lamenting that prostitution is not legal. If I remember correctly, are we not a socialist country?

text: 如果卖淫合法了，它会成为一种正当的职业选择。
en: If prostitution were legalised, it would become a legitimate career choice.

text: 意思是，如果有一天，一个妇女，她遇到了生活困难，她需要钱的时候，会有人理所当然的对她说，你为什么不去卖？
en: The meaning is that if one day a woman encounters hardship in life and needs money, someone will righteously say to her, "Why don't you go and sell yourself?

text: 白天打工，晚上去卖，赚两份钱，你为什么不去？
en: Working by day and going to sell yourself by night, earning two incomes — why won't you do it?

text: 而她，如果拒绝，她的家人会埋怨她，为什么你不去卖？
en: And she, if she refuses, her family will blame her: why won't you go and sell yourself?

text: 人家都可以卖，为什么你不可以卖？
en: Others can sell themselves; why can't you?

text: 时间久了，家里贫困的原因，亲人没钱治病的原因，孩子没钱读书的原因，儿子没钱娶媳妇的原因，家里盖不起房子的原因，都“理所当然”的变成了这位妇女不愿意去卖，她“不努力”，她“不愿意付出”。
en: Over time, the reasons for the family's poverty, for relatives having no money for medical treatment, for children having no money for school, for sons having no money to take a wife, for the family being unable to build a house — all 'righteously' become this woman's unwillingness to sell herself, her 'lack of effort', her 'unwillingness to make an effort'.

text: 当卖淫合法，拒绝卖淫将失去正当性。
en: When prostitution is legal, refusing to prostitute oneself loses its legitimacy.

text: 每一个陷入困境的妇女，都会被逼着做出选择。
en: Every woman who falls into difficulty will be forced to make a choice.

text: 我们不知道自己会不会陷入绝境，什么时候陷入绝境，我不想社会主义中国变成这样一个逼迫妇女卖淫的地狱，所以我无法赞同卖淫合法化。
en: We do not know whether we ourselves will fall into despair, or when we will fall into despair. I do not want socialist China to become such a hell that forces women into prostitution, so I cannot agree with the legalisation of prostitution.

text: 这里面涉及到一个很残酷的黑暗逻辑，它不一定是对的，但也有其道理。
en: This involves a very cruel, dark logic. It may not be right, but it has its rationale.

text: 城市化不是人类自然形成的社群，它是权力的产物。
en: Urbanisation is not a community naturally formed by humans; it is the product of power.

text: 太过分散的社群很容易形成地方势力对抗权力。
en: Communities that are too dispersed easily form local forces that resist power.

text: 所以权力需要把大量人口集中起来方便管理和行驶权力，
en: Therefore power needs to concentrate large populations to facilitate management and the exercise of power,

text: 而当代城市化更进一步，这是资本主义彰显权力的产物。
en: And contemporary urbanisation goes further still; it is the product of capitalism displaying its power.

text: 为了维持金钱的权力，资本需要大量的自由劳动力，这群人基本由男性担任。
en: To maintain the power of money, capital requires a large pool of free labour, and this group is composed predominantly of men.

text: 资本为了维持金钱崇拜的社会秩序需要大量的社会生产，于是自由劳动力们在追逐金钱的号召下大量时间需要花费在过度工作上，无法专注于个人生活。
en: To sustain a social order that worships money, capital requires vast social production; thus, under the call to chase money, free labourers must spend a great deal of their time in overwork and cannot focus on their personal lives.

text: 这对于个人情感是一种巨大的压抑，是对个人自由的一种剥夺，是对个人欲望的一种贬斥。
en: This is a tremendous repression of personal emotion, a deprivation of personal freedom, and a denigration of personal desire.

text: 最重要的是，长时间的劳动使他们被迫放弃了追逐爱情和异性交流的权利，没有哪个男性会傻到任由如此明目张胆的被剥削。
en: Most importantly, prolonged labour forces them to give up the right to pursue love and to interact with the opposite sex. No man would be foolish enough to allow himself to be exploited so brazenly.

text: 所以资本需要一种便捷的方式快速的满足男性劳动力的欲望，各式各样的消费品是如是，金钱建立起来的社会地位等级如是，性工作者更是如此。
en: Therefore capital needs a convenient means to satisfy the desires of male labour quickly. All manner of consumer goods are thus; the social status hierarchy built upon money is thus; and sex workers are all the more so.

text: 性工作者在资本的主导下负责满足社会劳动力的性需求，而且必须是通过金钱交易的方式满足男性社会劳动力的性需求。
en: Under capital's domination, sex workers are responsible for satisfying the sexual needs of social labour, and this must be done through monetary transactions to satisfy the sexual needs of male social labour.

text: 只有在这种方式下，金钱才能得到最大程度的社会重视，金钱崇拜才能更加狂热，金钱操纵者的资本才能在社会上豁取更多的权力。
en: Only in this way can money receive the greatest social regard, can the worship of money grow more fanatical, and can the capital of money's manipulators seize greater power in society.

text: 而社会劳动力，尤其是男性社会劳动力，在用如此便捷的方式满足了性需求后，自然而然解决了与女性做情感交互的焦虑，从而可以花更多时间在工作之上。
en: And social labour, especially male social labour, having satisfied its sexual needs through such a convenient means, naturally resolves the anxiety of emotional interaction with women, and can thus spend more time on work.

text: 性工作者也是分三六九等。
en: Sex workers, too, are stratified into different grades.

text: 最高等级的性工作者赋予最高的社会地位，最多的曝光度，其本身也必然有最出色的相貌和最高的艺术造诣。
en: The highest-grade sex workers are accorded the highest social status and the greatest exposure, and they themselves must inevitably possess the most outstanding looks and the highest artistic attainment.

text: 她们负责在大部分时刻通过演艺，音乐，歌舞等方式，充当社会偶像，大部分时间拥有正常的工作与家庭，只在特定的小部分时刻服务与最顶级的权贵，
en: They are responsible, for the most part, for acting as social idols through acting, music, song and dance, and for most of the time they have normal jobs and families, serving only the most top-tier elites in specific, brief moments,

text: 她们甚至根本没意识到自身的性交易行为；其次是交际花一类的女性，游走与各色高层次男性之间，服务也仅服务与他们，通过恋爱与收礼物的方式不动声色的完成交易；
en: They may not even realise their own acts of sex trading; next are women of the socialite type, moving among all kinds of high-level men, serving only them, completing transactions quietly through romance and the receiving of gifts;

text: 再次是有组织有包装，打着模特健身教练瑜伽教练等职业的旗号服务于中产阶级的收价不斐的性工作者；再次是地方流氓控制的酒吧暗窑固定地点工作的性工作者；
en: Next are the organised and packaged sex workers who, under the banner of professions such as model, fitness coach and yoga instructor, serve the middle class at no small price; next are the sex workers who work at fixed locations such as bars and hidden brothels controlled by local hooligans;

text: 最后也是工作不固定的流莺。
en: And last are the itinerant street prostitutes with no fixed work.

text: 通过经年累月的网络传闻和街边八卦，我们也能推断出性工作者的来源也是五花八门。
en: Through years of online rumours and street gossip, we can also infer that the origins of sex workers are also varied.

text: 或者是被权力诱惑出卖自己；或者是是单纯为了在纵欲的同时赚钱；或者是因为爱情的缘故跟错了人被推入深渊；或者可能也是因为单纯的被侵害伸张无门最终精神崩溃。
en: Some are seduced by power and sell themselves; some simply want to indulge while earning money; some, for love's sake, follow the wrong person and are pushed into the abyss; and some may simply be victims of violation with nowhere to seek justice, ultimately suffering a mental breakdown.

text: 而性工作者之上，一定是有一个通过各种违法犯罪手段将她们收拢起来的组织，一个黑社会性质的犯罪团伙组织，一个资本收拢权力的白手套。
en: And above the sex workers there must be an organisation that gathers them through various illegal and criminal means — a criminal gang organisation of a mafia nature, a white-glove through which capital amasses power.

text: 而这么一个由资本到涉黑到性工作者的链条中，成功的完成了对社会用交易来满足性需求的规训，同时也非常有效率的摧毁了社会对于家庭和爱情的憧憬及信仰。
en: And within this chain from capital to organised crime to sex workers, it successfully completes the disciplining of society to satisfy sexual needs through transactions, while also efficiently destroying society's yearning for and faith in family and love.

text: 一个数百万人口的城市必然要有数千到上万的性工作者来满足劳动者的需求，如果少于这个数，资本必然会催动涉黑组织逼良为娼，将城市中的良家妇女从丈夫，父亲和男友的身边抢走，通过各种威逼利诱将她异化成为一个性工作者。
en: A city of several million people must have thousands to tens of thousands of sex workers to satisfy the needs of labourers. If there are fewer than this number, capital will inevitably stir up organised-crime groups to force decent women into prostitution, snatching honourable women from the city away from their husbands, fathers and boyfriends, and through various threats and inducements alienating her into becoming a sex worker.

text: 所以我们也不难看出为什么社会有那么强大的声音要合法化性工作者了。
en: So it is not difficult to see why society has such a strong voice calling for the legalisation of sex workers.

text: 毕竟自古以来，妓女，佣兵和工匠就是最古老的行业，是商业构成最重要的基石。
en: After all, since ancient times, prostitutes, mercenaries and craftsmen have been the oldest trades and the most important cornerstone of commerce.

text: 而今天，他们异化成了性工作者，流氓无产阶级和无产阶级劳动者。
en: And today they have been alienated into sex workers, the lumpenproletariat and proletarian labourers.

text: 而且恰好在当今世界，资本主义横行于世，对社会的话语权最大。
en: Moreover, in today's world capitalism runs rampant, holding the greatest discourse power over society.

text: 11月7日分割，我看到很多留言都被屏蔽了。
en: Split on 7 November: I noticed that many comments had been hidden.

text: 我在此郑重告知，我并没有屏蔽大家回复。
en: I hereby solemnly inform you that I have not blocked everyone's replies.

text: 大家有什么想说的也可以私信给我。
en: If you have anything you wish to say, you may also send me a private message.
